subject: Expansion request: uplift cadence and co-term to Dec 31
messages:
From: Lucia Gomez <lucia@thermexa.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & expansion — need uplift + co-term

Hi Dylan,

Hope you had a good week. Quick note from our side — Thermexa is seeing a meaningful usage spike in our AI assistant (Q1 pilot went well) and we need to expand capacity mid-contract. We were hoping to align the additional commitment with our fiscal year (co-term to Dec 31) and get a predictable uplift price rather than a spot top-up.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide a tiered uplift plan for an additional ~3M tokens/month (estimated, may ramp over 6 months), co-term to 2027-12-31, and a discount band as usage increases? Also please include invoice and PO timing since procurement will need that.

I’ve CC’d procurement (procurement@thermexa.com) to loop in the paperwork. If it helps, we can do a 30-minute call next week to walk numbers.

Thanks —
Lucia Gomez
Head of Product
Thermexa

Attachment: Thermexa_Uplift_Request_20270401.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucia Gomez <lucia@thermexa.com>
Cc: procurement@thermexa.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion — need uplift + co-term

Hi Lucia — thanks for the note and congrats on the pilot results, great to hear.

I took a first pass at a lightweight uplift schedule and two pricing bands (conservative ramp vs accelerated ramp) — attaching the spreadsheet. High level questions before I model final numbers:
- Do you expect the 3M tokens/month to be steady after ramp or continue to grow?
- Are you able to co-term to 2027-12-31 on the added commitment?
- Any internal PO/payment constraints (Net30, Net45)?

I’m available Tue/Thu next week 9–11 PT for a 30-min sync if that works. If you prefer, I can also propose a draft amendment and a short LOI to lock the commercial terms while legal runs standard redlines.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0199

Attachment: Thermexa_Uplift_Schedule_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Lucia Gomez <lucia@thermexa.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@thermexa.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion — need uplift + co-term

Thanks Dylan — answers below:
- We expect 3M tokens/month nominal, but likely a small month-over-month ramp first 2 months (so model a 20% ramp then steady).
- Yes, we can co-term the added commitment to 2027-12-31 (single renewal cadence preferred).
- Procurement requires Net30 and our standard PO flow; I attached our procurement form for reference.

We also want the uplift priced in bands: 0–1.5M add’l tokens/month, 1.5–3M, and 3M+. If there’s a retention incentive (credit if we renew at year end) that would help internal sign-off.

Available for a call Tue 4/6 at 10:00 PT.

–Lucia

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal & expansion — Thermexa uplift + co-term (need guidance)

Team — forwarding Thermexa’s ask (see threads above and the procurement form). Quick context: 3M tokens/month uplift (20% ramp first month), want co-term to 12/31 and tiered discount bands. Procurement needs Net30 and PO flow. They’re also asking for a retention credit at renewal.

What I’m thinking: two options to propose quickly at the Tuesday call —
1) Staged uplift (recommended): 6-month commitment for incremental 3M tokens/month priced at 12% off list, with a 3% retention credit applied if they renew into annual with equal or greater commit. Invoices Net30.
2) Conservative: Quarter-by-quarter top-up with blended 8% off list and no retention credit (less upside for Redwood).

Irene — how flexible are we on the retention credit mechanics vs. offering a one-time onboarding credit? Sean — do we need AE manager/discount cap sign-off for the 12%?

Thanks,
Dylan

Thanks for the roundup, Dylan. Comments:
- 12% is within AE headroom for a staged uplift tied to a multi-month commit but above that requires manager approval. Monica, can you confirm the discount cap for this cohort?
- Offer a ramped discount ladder in the amendment: 8% for 0–1.5M, 10% for 1.5–3M, 12% at 3M+.
- For retention credit, prefer a one-time credit (equivalent of 2 weeks of add’l capacity) applied at renewal rather than an open-ended percent rebate — simpler for billing/recognition.
- PO/Net30 acceptable.

Let’s propose the staged amendment and walk procurement through the calculator on the call. I’ll be on the lock call if needed.

S.
